target_service.title: Target Service
target_service.description: Server-selected business listener only; never supplied by browser

message.title: Message
message.description: Allowlisted, sanitized user-facing detail; never raw subprocess/API output

code.title: Code
code.description: HTTP 503: storage_busy (bounded lock contention), storage_io_error (IO/read-only/full), or storage_unavailable (other storage failures). Unknown codes retain the same error envelope and HTTP status.
